baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic frame in وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ and the partitive مِنكُم around the agent noun مُّكَذِّبِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The double assertion encloses knowledge of a subset within the addressed group. The knowledge branch supplies clear apprehension, while the form-II denial branch makes the subset agents who assign falsehood to a claim or its bearer; the verse therefore discerns an internally mixed audience rather than addressing a uniform outside enemy.

activation_trace.role: Knowing as a thing becoming clear supplies the assured apprehension of the audience's internal division.
Declaring a thing or person false makes the named subset active rejecters of a claim, not merely speakers of lies.

changed_reading.before: God says that He knows some hearers deny.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs assured discernment inside one mixed address, identifying a resident subset whose defining act is to pronounce the communicated claim false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَعْلَمُ joined to the partitive مِنكُم and the plural category مُّكَذِّبِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The distinguishing-mark branch of ع ل م sharpens knowledge into discrimination: مِنكُم draws a boundary within the group, and the truth-versus-falsehood branch of ك ذ ب names the axis on which that boundary is legible. This is not a second lexical translation of نعلم, but a model of what its knowing does in the sentence.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points something out supplies the classificatory effect of knowing within مِنكُم.
Falsehood opposed to truth supplies the contrast by which the internal subset is distinguished.

changed_reading.before: The clause is only an assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The asserted knowledge also functions as an epistemic marking-out of a falsehood-bearing faction embedded among the addressees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first fixes a reality that corresponds to truth, then narrates an earlier community's active declaration of falsity, a listener-striking confrontation, and destruction. The same denial root in the focus agent noun turns the people مِنكُم into the present recurrence of that failed attempt to label reality false.

activation_trace.role: The focus agent noun anchors the model in people who actively attribute falsehood.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the object that a denial cannot alter.
The earlier finite act of declaring false turns the focus noun into a recurring actor pattern.
A rebuke that strikes the hearer gives denial a confrontation that reaches its audience.
Falling into destruction supplies the narrated outcome attached to the prior denial.

structural_cues: The same ك ذ ب root occurs as a finite act in 69:4 and as an agent noun in 69:49, while 69:5 follows the narrated denial with destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed reality, prior active denial, a hearer-striking event, and ensuing destruction; I supply the recurrence-and-consequence arrow from that sequence to the present subset. A live alternative is that the opening history only exemplifies denial rather than classifying the current deniers.

changed_reading.before: Some current addressees reject the message.
changed_reading.after: Those deniers reactivate a known historical posture: they try to assign falsehood to a reality whose arrival and consequences are not changed by their verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The message is configured as a reminder meant to be held inwardly and, immediately before the focus, as a reminder for those who place themselves under protection. Against that reception path, مُّكَذِّبِينَ names the alternative operation performed by another subset of the same audience: expelling or negating the claim rather than containing it.

activation_trace.role: Active attribution of falsehood anchors the negative reception path in the focus noun.
Something that causes remembrance supplies the message's intended reactivating function.
Gathering meaning into the heart supplies the receptive containment opposed to denial.
Placing oneself within protection supplies the practical result of receiving the reminder.

structural_cues: 69:12 pairs تذكرة with a receptive ear, and 69:48 immediately precedes the focus with a reminder for the protected before 69:49 partitions out deniers مِنكُم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, inward retention, self-protection, and active denial; I read them as two reception trajectories within one address. The alternative is that the labels describe already settled identities rather than responses being enacted.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies a fixed class of unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The verse marks a live reception fork inside the audience: some contain the reminder until it becomes protection, while another subset acts on it by declaring it false.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier context converts divine knowledge into the first phase of an audit trajectory: the addressees are brought out for view, concealment is removed, persons are gathered into readable records, and account follows. The known subset in 69:49 is therefore not only privately recognized; it is already legible ahead of public individuation.

activation_trace.role: Clear apprehension anchors the initial, presently asserted phase of the audit.
Bringing something out for inspection supplies the transition from known status to public presentation.
Removing hiddenness supplies the disclosure that prevents the internal faction from remaining concealed.
Entering a name into a register or group supplies individual classification in the disclosed record.
Reading and recitation make the registered classification publicly retrievable.
Counting and account supply the adjudicative endpoint of the disclosure sequence.

structural_cues: The second-person plural تُعْرَضُونَ and مِنكُم in the no-hidden-thing clause address the same social field that 69:49 partitions internally.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies presentation, removal of concealment, books, reading, and account; I supply the temporal arrow from present divine knowledge to future public audit. The alternative is that these scenes establish general accountability without specifically unfolding the knowing in 69:49.

changed_reading.before: God privately knows who the deniers are.
changed_reading.after: The present knowing is the hidden first stage of an audit that will expose, register, read out, and account for the deniers as individuals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath spans what the addressees see and what they do not see. Read through that horizon, وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ is not a redundant omniscience formula: it contrasts divine apprehension of the mixed audience with the audience's bounded visual access, including deniers whose posture may not yet be outwardly visible.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear to the knower anchors apprehension that is not limited by human visibility.
The oath branch supplies the emphatic evidentiary frame that opens the visible and invisible contrast.
Physical sight supplies the finite human evidence horizon that the following negated repetition extends beyond.

structural_cues: 69:38-39 repeat تُبْصِرُونَ across the antithesis of what is seen and what is not seen; 69:49 then shifts to emphatic first-person plural knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an oath over seen and unseen domains followed by emphatic knowing; I infer that the focus knowledge crosses the addressees' sight limit. The alternative is that the oath authenticates the discourse generally and does not characterize how the deniers are known.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are an observable faction among the audience.
changed_reading.after: The faction is known across the boundary of visible and invisible evidence, so its embedded posture need not be publicly detectable to the other addressees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late speech sequence identifies a messenger's utterance as delivered revelation, then stages the contrary hypothesis of invented attribution and gives it an immediate seizure-and-severance test with no possible interposer. Because the focus denial branch is relational, مُّكَذِّبِينَ now names people advancing an accusation about message provenance against a discourse that exposes even its bearer to an integrity test.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report or its bearer false anchors denial as an accusatory relation requiring an object.
Messenger and message supply the human bearer and transmitted claim targeted by the accusation.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies the asserted provenance of the message.
Saying what did not occur or falsely attributing it supplies the exact counter-hypothesis tested by the passage.
Being taken to account for fault supplies immediate enforcement of the provenance test.
Severing and separation supply the decisive consequence if fabricated attribution occurred.
Interposition by a barrier supplies, under negation, the absence of any escape from that test.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from قول رسول through تنزيل, then a لو counterfactual about تقوّل, followed by taking, severing, and the negation of any blocker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies message bearer, claimed delivery, a fabrication counterfactual, sanction, and no barrier; I read that chain as an internal integrity test answering the deniers' accusation. The alternative is that 69:44-47 only warns the messenger and is not aimed back at the deniers.

changed_reading.before: The deniers generally call the revelation untrue.
changed_reading.after: They make a specific provenance accusation against messenger and message, while the surrounding discourse answers with a counterfactual test that would expose and terminate fabrication at its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence recasts active denial as an attempted obstruction of truth whose endpoint is regret, followed by truth made manifest and knowledge stabilized beyond doubt. Divine knowing in the focus already sees through that obstructive posture, so denial becomes a temporary operation within a disclosure trajectory rather than a successful verdict on the message.

activation_trace.role: Clear knowledge supplies apprehension that already penetrates the deniers' present posture.
Assigning falsehood supplies the attempted adverse verdict that the later sequence reverses.
Regret over what has been lost supplies the affective result of the failed denial.
Blocking or veiling truth supplies the operative posture into which denial develops.
Establishing and manifesting truth supplies the reversal of the attempted obstruction.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the terminal epistemic state after denial.

structural_cues: The uninterrupted closing sequence places مُّكَذِّبِينَ, حَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ, and حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ in successive ayat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, regret, truth-obstruction, truth-manifestation, and stable knowledge; I supply the arrow from attempted obstruction to exposed regret and certainty. The alternative is that deniers and coverers are adjacent categories without a staged transformation between them.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a present judgment made by some addressees.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a temporary covering act already transparent to divine knowledge; its trajectory runs toward failed obstruction, regret, manifested truth, and certainty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the branch image of deceptively patterned cloth into an agent noun for deniers. It remains anchored in focus ك ذ ب and is analogically reinforced by the adjacent covering and uncovering roots; downstream prose should present it only as a qualified image of deceptive social appearance, never as a lexical translation of مُّكَذِّبِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The embedded faction مِنكُم and the branch-distant appearance image available under focus root ك ذ ب.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing sign supplies the possibility of recognizing an embedded posture beneath its social presentation.
A patterned cloth whose appearance deceives supplies the exploratory image of denial as a misleading surface.
Covering supplies the adjacent material action that lets the deceptive-surface image cohere.
Stripping away a cover supplies the eventual exposure of the misleading surface.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are simply an openly identifiable opposition group.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, some deniers may be woven into the audience behind a persuasive social surface that misstates their posture, yet remains distinguishable to divine knowledge and subject to uncovering.

strongest_changes: The partitive مِنكُم becomes a reception fork inside one audience rather than a generic label for an outside enemy.
Divine knowing becomes the first stage of an audit moving from hidden mixture to public display, record, reading, and account.
مُّكَذِّبِينَ becomes a specific accusation about message provenance answered by the messenger-revelation-fabrication test sequence.
The closing cover, regret, truth, and certainty cues turn denial from a successful verdict into a temporary obstructive act with an exposure trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus alone held emphatic knowledge, internal partition, and active attribution of falsehood. Context activated several coexisting mechanisms: historical recurrence, divergent reception, public audit, knowledge beyond sight, message-integrity testing, and movement from obstruction to exposed certainty.
remaining_uncertainties: The distinguishing-mark branch of ع ل م may only sharpen the syntax analogically rather than add a separate baseline mechanism.
The fabrication counterfactual may warn the messenger without directly functioning as an answer to the deniers.
The covering-to-uncovering relation across ك ف ر and ح س ر may be a productive adjacent analogy rather than a deliberate lexical progression.
